answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, weighted by independent path length, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Every claim climbs the grove of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the umber re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. What survives to the crystal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
